ui.app.name: LingoReel
ui.computer.adjustedApart: The settings follow a {level} level computer; this one is of another level.
ui.computer.changed.text: It is a {level} level computer, and the settings are adjusted to a {adjusted} level one. Adjust again to this computer? What you chose by hand stays as it is, and "Not now" does not ask again on this computer.
ui.computer.changed.title: This computer changed.
ui.computer.confirm: This turns on or off what the {level} level decides, such as the voice AI, also what you changed by hand. Adjust?
ui.computer.help: As a game does, the app reads the computer on its first opening and picks what starts on. At the Basic level (2 cores or fewer, or under 4 GB of memory) the voice AI starts off; at Medium and High (4 cores or more and 8 GB or more), on. You can change each option later. If the computer changes level, the app asks before adjusting.
ui.computer.title: This computer
ui.editor.export.help: Writes the subtitle as you see it, with the corrections and the sync, to an .srt or .ass file you choose. Useful for another player.
ui.editor.help: With the video paused, click a subtitle in the film's window, or use the buttons below, to correct the text or the times of a line. The original is never lost. The corrections are kept in the app's own folder, even if the video is renamed or moved, and the video is never changed.
ui.editor.now.label: Current position
ui.editor.pausedOnly: Pause the video to correct a subtitle
ui.editor.redo.label: Redo
ui.editor.restore.label: Restore the original
ui.editor.restore.tip: Brings the line back to the subtitle file's text and times

ui.editor.stale.one: A kept correction no longer applies: the original line changed in the subtitle file.
ui.editor.stale.other: {count} kept corrections no longer apply: the original lines changed in the subtitle file.

ui.editor.title: Correct subtitles
ui.editor.undo.label: Undo
ui.help.label: Help: {topic}
ui.home.formats: Works best with .mkv. It also opens .mp4, .avi, .mov and .wmv with subtitle files.
ui.home.loading: Reading the video and the subtitles…
ui.home.loadingNote: On long films this takes a few seconds.
ui.home.orChoose: or choose the file on your computer.
ui.install.dismissed: You dismissed the recommendations. Install a supported player and open the video again.
ui.install.none: No supported player found. Install one to watch; LingoReel finds it by itself afterwards.
ui.install.winget: The installation uses Windows' winget; Windows may ask for your permission.
ui.karaoke.help: Shows the next line ahead of time, so you can get ready and speak along with the actor. The preview shows a few seconds before, only in long pauses; both times are in Settings › Study. While the line is spoken, the subtitle fills like in karaoke, following the actor's voice; when the voice cannot be followed, the fill is an estimate, because the subtitle does not carry the time of each word.
ui.karaoke.indicator.help: The bar, as wide as the text, shrinks until the line starts. The countdown shows the seconds left, in real time (at 0.75× it lasts longer).
ui.karaoke.indicator.label: Time until the line
ui.karaoke.repeat.help: When a line ends, the video goes back to its preview and repeats it, as many times as you choose. Seeking elsewhere in the video starts the count again.
ui.karaoke.repeat.label: Repeat each line
ui.karaoke.replay.help: Goes back to the start of the current line's preview (or the last one's), to train once more.
ui.karaoke.replay.helpKey: Goes back to the start of the current line's preview (or the last one's), to train once more. In the film's window, the key is {key}.
ui.karaoke.replay.label: Train again
ui.karaoke.replay.tip: Train again ({key} in the film's window)
ui.karaoke.title: Karaoke mode
ui.karaoke.voice.ahead: Following the voice: analyzed ahead with FFmpeg.
ui.karaoke.voice.battery: The computer is on battery: the voice AI rests and the fill follows the estimate.
ui.karaoke.voice.estimate: The voice could not be followed now: the fill follows the estimate.
ui.karaoke.voice.live: Following the voice: listening to the player.
ui.karaoke.voice.off: The voice AI is off in the settings: the fill follows the estimate.
ui.panel.label: Panel
ui.passage.atEnd: End of the passage: Play repeats it.
ui.passage.atEndKey: End of the passage: {key} or Play repeats it.
ui.passage.gap.label: Gap between repetitions
ui.passage.goal.help: After this number of repetitions, the passage ends by itself.
ui.passage.goal.label: Goal
ui.passage.help: Mark the start and the end of a passage of the film: it is saved and starts repeating. At the end of the passage the video pauses; Play goes back to the start and plays it again. Seeking outside the passage keeps it paused until you come back.
ui.passage.helpKey: Mark the start and the end of a passage of the film: it is saved and starts repeating. At the end of the passage the video pauses; Play or {key} goes back to the start and plays it again. Seeking outside the passage keeps it paused until you come back.
ui.passage.hint.text: {start} marks the start and {end} marks the end: the passage is saved and starts repeating. The shortcuts work in the film's window, here and with the player in front.
ui.passage.ladder.help: Each repetition gives one less help: first both subtitles, then only the study subtitle, then no subtitle, to train your ear.
ui.passage.ladder.label: Subtitle ladder
ui.passage.mark.label: Mark
ui.passage.more: Choose by times and more options
ui.passage.onEnd.help: Pause at the end waits for you to press Play. Repeat without stopping goes back by itself, after the chosen gap.
ui.passage.onEnd.label: At the end of the passage
ui.passage.onEnd.topic: at the end of the passage
ui.passage.progressive.help: The first repetitions play slower: 0.75×, then 0.90× and then 1.00×. First you understand, then you train at the real pace.
ui.passage.progressive.label: Progressive speed
ui.passage.saveAs.help: Keeps the passage in the app's folder, with the options in use, to study it again another day. Without a name, it is named by its times; a name that already exists is replaced. A passage marked with the end shortcut is already saved.
ui.passage.saveAs.label: Save under another name
ui.passage.snap.help: Stretches the passage so that no sentence is cut in the middle, with half a second to spare before the first line. It also applies to the passages marked with the shortcuts.
ui.passage.snap.label: Fit to the lines
ui.passage.suspended: Passage paused: the video left its range.
ui.passage.thisLine.help: Fills the start and the end with the study subtitle's line on screen (or the last one that showed).
ui.passage.thisLine.label: This line
ui.passage.title: Study a passage
ui.passages.delete.label: Delete the passage "{name}"
ui.passages.outside.note: It starts after the end of this video: it may be from another version of the film.
ui.passages.outside.tip: This passage starts after the end of this video
ui.passages.rename.label: Rename the passage "{name}"
ui.playing.audio.fixed: This player does not switch the audio track while the video plays.
ui.playing.audio.label: Audio track
ui.playing.mode.help: Both shows both subtitles, and the translation key ({key}) hides and shows the translation. Translation on demand starts with the study subtitle only: the key shows the translation when you need it. Translation always visible never hides the translation. It applies to this video only; the default is in the Settings.
ui.playing.mode.label: Study mode
ui.playing.playback.title: Playback
ui.playing.speed.label: Speed
ui.playing.subtitles.help: Switch the study subtitle or the translation without stopping the video, or add a subtitle file from any folder. The added file comes back the next time you open this video, and the sync and the corrections are kept for each subtitle.
ui.playing.subtitles.title: Subtitles
ui.playing.sync.help: If a subtitle shows before or after the line is spoken, adjust it here or with the shortcuts, in the film's window or in this panel: {primary}, {translation}. Holding the key speeds it up.
ui.playing.sync.helpPrimaryNone: the study subtitle has no shortcut
ui.playing.sync.title: Sync
ui.playing.title: Playing in the player
ui.playing.translation.locked: The translation always shows in this study mode
ui.session.audio.fixed: {name} does not let the app switch the audio track; choose it in its own menu.
ui.session.audio.label: Audio track
ui.session.audio.title: Audio
ui.session.forget.confirm: Delete the corrections, the sync, the saved passages and where you stopped in this video?
ui.session.forget.help: For each video, LingoReel keeps the chosen subtitles and mode, the sync, the corrections, the saved passages, the speed, the karaoke mode and where you stopped. Forgetting deletes all of that for this video; the video and the subtitles are not touched.
ui.session.forget.title: This video
ui.session.listening.label: Listening to the film to find the subtitle that matches it (part {stretch} of {stretches})
ui.session.listening.question: The app is listening to the film to choose the subtitle that matches it. If you wait, the film starts by itself with the best subtitle as soon as it finishes.
ui.session.listening.title: Still listening to the film
ui.session.listening.waiting: The film starts by itself, with the best subtitle, as soon as the app finishes listening.
ui.session.mode.help: Both shows both subtitles all the time. Translation on demand, the recommended mode for studying, shows only the study subtitle: the translation key shows the translation when you need it. Translation always visible never hides the translation. Each profile's default is in the Settings, with the key.
ui.session.mode.label: Mode
ui.session.passages.blocked: Choose a subtitle and a player to watch
ui.session.passages.empty: No saved passage yet. During the video, {start} marks the start and {end} marks the end and saves it.
ui.session.passages.help: Passages of the film kept to study again, in the app's folder. During the video, {start} marks the start of a passage and {end} marks the end: the passage is saved with its times as its name and starts repeating.
ui.session.passages.title: Saved passages
ui.session.player.alwaysHelp: LingoReel opens the videos with this player from now on, as long as it is installed.
ui.session.player.label: Open with
ui.session.player.missing: Your preferred player is no longer installed; another one was chosen.
ui.session.player.title: Player
ui.session.subtitles.help: The study subtitle is the one in the language you study; the other is the translation. Subtitles downloaded to the video's folder or its subfolders show here, and their timing is checked against the video. A subtitle from another folder comes in through “Add a subtitle file…” and comes back next time.
ui.session.subtitles.missing: This video has no subtitles. Download a subtitle (.srt) and use “Add a subtitle file…”, or put the file in the video's folder.
ui.session.subtitles.title: Subtitles
ui.settings.about.notices: LingoReel includes third-party software, each under its own license, which its authors ask to go along with the app. None of it belongs to the author of LingoReel.
ui.settings.about.title: About
ui.settings.appearance.app.help: The theme, accent color, font and text size of this window. Without a color of its own, each theme uses its blue. The changes apply at once.
ui.settings.appearance.app.ownAccent: Use an accent color of my own
ui.settings.appearance.bar.alt: Preview of the control bar over a sample video, with the speed list open and the volume above 100%
ui.settings.appearance.bar.caption: This is how the bar looks over the video, with the speed list open and the mouse on the play button.
ui.settings.appearance.bar.help: The bar that shows when the mouse goes over the bottom of the video, and its menus. The changes apply at once, also to the open video. The size applies to the bar and the menus.
ui.settings.appearance.bar.hideDelayHelp: How long the bar stays on screen after the mouse leaves it.
ui.settings.appearance.bar.icon: Color of the icons and texts
ui.settings.appearance.bar.menu: Background color of the menus and tips
ui.settings.appearance.bar.title: Control bar
ui.settings.appearance.edit.alt: Sample of the correction box with the chosen colors
ui.settings.appearance.edit.caption: This is how the box that opens in place of the subtitle looks. The line is written in the subtitle's font.
ui.settings.appearance.edit.help: The box that opens in place of the subtitle when you double-click it with the video paused, to correct the line. The changes apply the next time it opens.
ui.settings.appearance.edit.title: Correction box
ui.settings.appearance.help: “Windows theme” follows the system's light or dark mode. It changes at once, without restarting.
ui.settings.appearance.title: App appearance
ui.settings.association.help: Right-clicking a video (.mkv, .mp4 and others) shows “Watch with LingoReel”, and the app joins the “Open with” list. Each video's default program does not change, and turning it off takes everything back. It applies only to your Windows user.
ui.settings.association.label: Show LingoReel in the videos' menu and in “Open with”
ui.settings.association.off: Done: LingoReel left the videos' menu.
ui.settings.association.on: Done: right-click a video to see the option.
ui.settings.association.title: Open videos from Windows
ui.settings.diagnostics.copied: Diagnostics copied. Paste it into your support message.
ui.settings.diagnostics.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it.
ui.settings.diagnostics.help: The state of the app, the computer and the open video, to report a problem. It has no subtitle text, and nothing is sent: you copy it and paste it wherever you want.
ui.settings.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
ui.settings.ffmpeg.label: FFmpeg
ui.settings.ffmpeg.slow: FFmpeg did not answer in time because the computer is busy. It is looked for again when you open this screen or a video.
ui.settings.fill.standIn: That color disappears over the study subtitle's color. On the video, the fill uses {color}.
ui.settings.fill.turnOff: To not fill the subtitle, turn off "Fill the subtitle word by word".
ui.settings.folder.note: It holds the profiles, each video's corrections and passages (in the "projects" folder), the kept thumbnails (in "thumbnails") and, in the "logs" folder, the logs of the last 14 days, useful to report a problem.
ui.settings.folder.title: Settings folder
ui.settings.language.help: The language of the app's menus, buttons and notices. Same as Windows uses Windows' display language when the app speaks it; otherwise, English. The languages you study are in the profile, under Subtitles.
ui.settings.language.label: App language
ui.settings.language.saved: Language saved. The app speaks it now.
ui.settings.language.title: Language
ui.settings.leave.question: Save the changes before closing?
ui.settings.notices.help: When you move a subtitle earlier or later with the shortcuts, a small notice shows in the corner of the video for a moment, like “Study subtitle (English): −0.150 s”. It applies to every profile.
ui.settings.notices.sync: Show on the video which subtitle the sync changed
ui.settings.notices.title: Notices on the video
ui.settings.packs.basic: This computer is at the Basic level: the voice models may make the app heavy. You can download them anyway, at your own risk.
ui.settings.packs.help: Each language has a model that finds, in the film's sound, where each word of the subtitle is said. It is downloaded only when you ask, one language at a time, from LingoReel's own GitHub, and checked before it is used. It stays in the app's folder and runs only on this computer, sending nothing. The models are open and free.
ui.settings.packs.intro: Download the language of the films you watch. What is recommended depends on this computer's level.
ui.settings.packs.title: Voice languages
ui.settings.playback.audio.help: The audio the app chooses by itself when the video has more than one.
ui.settings.playback.audio.label: Preferred audio language
ui.settings.playback.open.title: When a video opens
ui.settings.playback.precision.help: How far the precision shortcuts move in the video, to find the exact start of a line. The other jumps are 5, 10 and 30 seconds.
ui.settings.playback.precision.helpKeys: How far the precision shortcuts ({keys}) move in the video, to find the exact start of a line. The other jumps are 5, 10 and 30 seconds.
ui.settings.playback.precision.label: Precision step
ui.settings.playback.seek.title: Forward and back
ui.settings.playback.speed.help: The speed the video starts at. During the film, it changes in the panel or in the video's bar.
ui.settings.playback.speed.label: Starting speed
ui.settings.playback.volumeStepHelp: How much each press of the volume keys changes the volume. Holding the key, the volume goes up or down little by little, about 20% per second, up to the player's maximum.
ui.settings.playback.volumeStepHelpKeys: How much each press of {keys} changes the volume. Holding the key, the volume goes up or down little by little, about 20% per second, up to the player's maximum.
ui.settings.players.preferred.help: The player this profile uses whenever it is installed. In “Automatic”, the app chooses the best one it finds on the computer.
ui.settings.players.preferred.label: Open videos with
ui.settings.players.preferred.title: Preferred player
ui.settings.players.searchAgain: The app looks for the player by itself again.
ui.settings.players.where.help: The app looks for the players in the usual places. If yours is in another folder, choose its program (the .exe file).
ui.settings.players.where.title: Where the players are
ui.settings.preview.alt: Subtitle preview: a sample sentence in the study subtitle and its translation.
ui.settings.preview.altCue: Subtitle preview in karaoke mode, before the line: the study sentence in the preview color, with the time left, and its translation.
ui.settings.preview.altFill: Subtitle preview in karaoke mode: the study sentence with its first half in the fill color, and its translation.
ui.settings.preview.altNotice: Subtitle preview with a notice at the top of the video: the study sentence and its translation.
ui.settings.preview.caption: Preview on a video of this size. It follows the changes before you save.
ui.settings.preview.cued: Before the line: the study subtitle's sentence shows ahead of time, with the time left.
ui.settings.preview.filled: In karaoke mode: half of the study subtitle's sentence has been spoken and shows in the fill color.
ui.settings.preview.noticed: At the top, a sample notice.
ui.settings.profile.confirmDelete: Delete the profile “{name}”? Its choices cannot be recovered.
ui.settings.profile.created: Profile “{name}” created as a copy of “{from}”.
ui.settings.profile.help: A profile keeps your choices for one language: subtitles, colors, shortcuts, karaoke mode and player. Create one for each language you study, like “English” and “French”.
ui.settings.profile.newName: Name of the new profile (copy of “{from}”)
ui.settings.profile.saveFirst: Save or discard the changes before switching profiles.
ui.settings.profile.title: Profile
ui.settings.reset.confirm: Restore the default? It cannot be undone.
ui.settings.reset.note: Brings every choice of the profile “{name}” back to the default: subtitles, colors, shortcuts, karaoke mode and player. The profile's name stays.
ui.settings.reset.title: Restore the profile
ui.settings.saved: Settings saved. The open video already uses the new choices.
ui.settings.shortcut.button: {name}: {keys}. Click and press the new keys
ui.settings.shortcut.default: Back to the default shortcut of “{name}”
ui.settings.shortcut.windows: The Windows key cannot be part of a shortcut.
ui.settings.shortcuts.intro: The shortcuts work in the film's window and, while the video plays, in the app's panel (outside text fields). Click a shortcut and press the new keys: up to three, like Ctrl+Shift+P. Alt+Shift is not accepted, because it switches the keyboard language in Windows. The × leaves a command without a shortcut.
ui.settings.shortcuts.syncHelp: These work with the film's window or the app's panel in front: in other programs the same keys keep typing as usual.
ui.settings.study.fill.help: The subtitle fills from left to right, following the actor's voice when "Follow the actors' voice" is on. Otherwise, it is an estimate by the syllables, because the subtitle does not carry the time of each word.
ui.settings.study.fill.label: Fill the subtitle word by word
ui.settings.study.indicator.help: A thin bar that shrinks until the line, or the seconds left (5… 4… 3…), in real time.
ui.settings.study.indicator.label: Time until the line
ui.settings.study.karaoke.enable: Turn on karaoke mode when a video opens
ui.settings.study.karaoke.help: Shows the next line ahead of time, so you can get ready and speak along with the actor, and fills the subtitle while they speak. It can also be turned on and off in the panel while the film plays.
ui.settings.study.karaoke.title: Karaoke mode
ui.settings.study.key.help: In the film's window and in the panel, this key shows and hides the translation. With the box unchecked, each press switches: press to show, press again to hide. Checked, in Translation on demand, the translation shows only while the key is held. In Translation always visible the key does nothing.
ui.settings.study.key.hold: Show the translation only while the key is held
ui.settings.study.key.label: Key
ui.settings.study.key.title: Translation key
ui.settings.study.lead.help: How long before the line the preview shows. It never covers the previous line: in a shorter pause, it shows only at the end of the pause.
ui.settings.study.lead.label: Lead time
ui.settings.study.minGap.help: The preview shows only after a pause with no line at least this long. In fast dialogues it does not show.
ui.settings.study.minGap.label: Shortest gap
ui.settings.study.mode.help: Both shows both subtitles, and the translation key hides and shows the translation. Translation on demand, the recommended mode for studying, starts with the study subtitle only: the key shows the translation when you need it. Translation always visible never hides the translation. On the session screen and in the panel you can change the mode of a single video.
ui.settings.study.mode.label: When a video opens
ui.settings.study.mode.title: Study mode
ui.settings.study.repeat.help: How many times each line plays again before moving on. 0 turns it off.
ui.settings.study.repeat.label: Repeat each line
ui.settings.style.background.help: A semi-transparent box behind the subtitle, which helps reading over bright scenes.
ui.settings.style.background.label: Background behind the text
ui.settings.style.background.title: Background
ui.settings.style.lineSpacing.help: The distance between the lines of the same subtitle. At 1×, it is the font's own spacing; the extra space is split above and below each line.
ui.settings.style.lineSpacing.label: Line spacing
ui.settings.style.position.help: Where the bottom of the subtitle sits, counted from the top of the video: 82% is near the bottom of the picture.
ui.settings.style.position.title: Position
ui.settings.style.preset.help: Changes the colors, the outline, the shadow and the background at once. The font, the size and the position stay as they are; afterwards you can adjust each detail.
ui.settings.style.preset.label: Ready-made style
ui.settings.style.sizeMode.help: “Follows the video”: the size is for a 1080-line video and grows or shrinks with the window. “Fixed”: the text stays the same size, whatever the window.
ui.settings.style.sizeMode.label: Font size
ui.settings.subtitles.both.intro: Each subtitle has its own font, size, colors and position. Choose which one to change:
ui.settings.subtitles.both.title: Both subtitles
ui.settings.subtitles.bottom.languageHel: The language the app chooses by itself for the translation.
ui.settings.subtitles.bottom.title: Translation · {language}
ui.settings.subtitles.gap.help: When both subtitles are close to each other, as in a long two-line speech, the distance between them is at least this, counted in translation lines. Otherwise, each one stays at the height chosen on its page.
ui.settings.subtitles.gap.label: Shortest distance between the subtitles (in lines)
ui.settings.subtitles.karaoke.fill: Fill the subtitle word by word
ui.settings.subtitles.karaoke.help: How karaoke mode shows on this subtitle, in three colors the preview shows: "Before the line" shows the sentence in the preview color, with the bar or the countdown; "Normal", in the subtitle's color; "Fill", the part the actor already said in the fill color. Turning karaoke mode on and choosing between the bar and the countdown is in Study › Karaoke mode.
ui.settings.subtitles.karaoke.title: Karaoke mode
ui.settings.subtitles.margins.help: The area where the subtitles may sit, for both of them. The values are parts of the video, so they stay right at any window size.
ui.settings.subtitles.margins.title: Margins
ui.settings.subtitles.notice.help: The short notices that show at the top of the video, like the sync or the volume notice. Choose “Notice” above the preview to see a sample.
ui.settings.subtitles.notice.title: Notices on the video
ui.settings.subtitles.order.help: Which subtitle goes on top when both show. The order never switches by itself: if the bottom one does not fit, the top one moves up to make room; if there is still no room, the bottom one shrinks and comes closer to the video's edge.
ui.settings.subtitles.order.label: Subtitle order
ui.settings.subtitles.selection.help: The frame that marks the line chosen to be corrected, with the video paused: a thin line in the chosen color, with a dark edge outside, to show on bright and dark pictures. It goes away when you click outside the line or press play.
ui.settings.subtitles.selection.title: Selected line
ui.settings.subtitles.sync.help: How far each press of the sync shortcuts ({primaryEarlier} and {primaryLater} for the study subtitle; {translationEarlier} and {translationLater} for the translation) moves the subtitle. Holding the key for 1 second, the larger step applies.
ui.settings.subtitles.sync.title: Sync
ui.settings.subtitles.together.help: The translation shows and goes along with the line it translates, even when its file starts or ends a little before or after. A translation that matches no line, such as a sign's, shows at its own time. Unchecked, each subtitle follows its own file's timing.
ui.settings.subtitles.together.label: Translation together with the study subtitle
ui.settings.subtitles.top.languageHelp: The language the app chooses by itself for the study subtitle when a video opens: the one you study.
ui.settings.subtitles.top.title: Study subtitle · {language}
ui.settings.subtitles.view.label: Preview
ui.settings.thumbnails.battery.help: On battery, a thumbnail is made only for the point under the mouse, so the battery lasts longer. Turn this on to make the whole film's thumbnails on battery too, as when plugged in.
ui.settings.thumbnails.battery.label: Also on battery
ui.settings.thumbnails.crowded: The disk is nearly full (less than 1 GB free). The thumbnails kept longest leave first, and new ones stay only in memory until you free some space.
ui.settings.thumbnails.ffmpeg.help: FFmpeg is a free program that does not come with the app, the same one used for the actors' voice. If it is already on the computer, the app finds it; otherwise, choose ffmpeg.exe or install the LGPL version with winget, straight from its authors. Without it, the bar shows only the time under the mouse.
ui.settings.thumbnails.ffmpeg.missing: FFmpeg not found: the bar shows only the time under the mouse.
ui.settings.thumbnails.help: When the mouse goes over the video's bar, a thumbnail of the frame at that point shows, like on video sites. The app makes the thumbnails with FFmpeg while the film plays, little by little and without disturbing the video. The changes apply at once, also to the open video, and to every profile on this computer.
ui.settings.thumbnails.keep.help: Kept on the disk, in the app's folder, a film's thumbnails show at once when it opens again, even renamed or moved. Each film takes up to 64 MB and all of them together up to 4 GB; the films opened longest ago leave first, and the disk always keeps at least 1 GB free. Remade at each opening, they stay only in memory and nothing is written to the disk.
ui.settings.thumbnails.keep.label: Where the thumbnails stay
ui.settings.thumbnails.on.label: Show thumbnails when the mouse is over the bar
ui.settings.thumbnails.title: Seek bar thumbnails
ui.settings.voice.battery.help: On battery, the AI rests so the battery lasts longer, and the fill follows the estimate. Turn this on to use the AI anyway. When plugged in, it comes back by itself.
ui.settings.voice.battery.label: Use the AI on battery too
ui.settings.voice.busy.help: On a computer that cannot keep up, the app goes back to the estimate by itself so as not to disturb the video. Turn this on to follow the voice anyway.
ui.settings.voice.busy.label: Follow the voice even when the computer is busy
ui.settings.voice.delay.help: Wireless headphones and speakers through the TV play the sound a little later. If the fill comes before the voice, raise this little by little (Bluetooth headphones: around 200 ms).
ui.settings.voice.delay.label: Sound delay
ui.settings.voice.ffmpeg.found: Using FFmpeg from {path}: the voice is analyzed ahead of the video.
ui.settings.voice.ffmpeg.help: FFmpeg is a free program that does not come with the app. If it is already on the computer, the app finds it; otherwise, choose ffmpeg.exe or install the LGPL version with winget, straight from its authors. Without it, the app listens to the player's sound.
ui.settings.voice.ffmpeg.missing: FFmpeg not found: the app listens to the player's sound while it plays.
ui.settings.voice.follow.label: Follow the actors' voice
ui.settings.voice.help: It comes on together with karaoke mode. The subtitle's fill follows the real voice: it moves while the actor speaks and stops in the pauses. With FFmpeg, the voice is analyzed a little ahead of the video; without it, the app listens to the player's sound while it plays. When the voice cannot be followed, the fill follows the estimate. These choices apply to every profile on this computer.
ui.settings.voice.model.help: A small artificial intelligence, which comes inside the app and runs only on this computer, without the internet, notices when someone is speaking in the film. It is how karaoke mode follows the actors' voice. It uses little of the processor; if the computer is very weak, turn it off, and the fill follows the estimate.
ui.settings.voice.model.label: Use the voice AI on this computer
ui.settings.voice.sensitivity.help: High counts as voice even what the AI thinks might be speech, like whispers and voices in the middle of music; low, only what it is sure is speech. Normal suits most films and cartoons.
ui.settings.voice.sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
ui.settings.voice.sync.help: If the study subtitle drifts from the voice midway through the film (a version with a scene more or less), the app notices it by the actors' voice and brings the subtitle back little by little, without touching your own adjustment. Your own sync adjustment always wins. It needs the voice AI on; at the Basic level, it starts off.
ui.settings.voice.sync.label: Keep the sync on the voice
ui.settings.voice.title: Actors' voice
ui.settings.voice.weak: This computer is at the Basic level, so the voice AI starts off. You can turn it on anyway, at your own risk: the app may get heavy and videos may take longer to open. With it off, the karaoke mode follows the estimate.
ui.settings.welcome.help: The questions of the first opening: the app language, the language you speak and the one you study, the study mode, the player and FFmpeg. If you choose another language to study, the app creates a new profile named after it and leaves the current one as it is.
ui.settings.welcome.title: Setup assistant
ui.settings.welcome.watching: End the video to open the setup.
ui.settings.window.help: The app stays in front of the other windows, even when you click another program. Turn this off so it can go behind them.
ui.settings.window.onTop: Keep the app always on top
ui.settings.window.title: Window
ui.video.label: Video
ui.welcome.language.again: Review the choices of the first opening. The language changes at once.
ui.welcome.language.intro: Welcome! Four quick questions make the app yours. You can skip them and change everything later in Settings.
ui.welcome.language.note: The language of the menus, buttons and notices. It changes at once.
ui.welcome.language.title: App language
ui.welcome.languages.intro: The app picks each video's subtitles and audio by these languages. You can change them for each video.
ui.welcome.languages.profile: Another language to study creates a new profile named after it. The current profile stays as it is.
ui.welcome.languages.same: Choose different languages: the translation must be in a language you already speak.
ui.welcome.languages.spokenNote: The translation subtitle shows in this language.
ui.welcome.languages.studied: Which language do you want to study?
ui.welcome.languages.studiedNote: The study subtitle and the audio are picked in this language.
ui.welcome.languages.title: Your languages
ui.welcome.mode.always: Both subtitles always on screen. Good to start with, when the language is still very new.
ui.welcome.mode.dual: Both subtitles on screen, and the translation key hides and shows the translation whenever you want.
ui.welcome.mode.intro: How the translation shows while you watch. You can change it for each video, on the session screen and in the panel.
ui.welcome.mode.onDemand: Only the study subtitle on screen. The translation key shows the translation when you need it.
ui.welcome.mode.title: Study mode
ui.welcome.subtitle: Getting started
ui.welcome.tools.ffmpegHelp: FFmpeg is free and optional. With it, the karaoke mode follows the actors' voice and the video's bar shows thumbnails. Without it, the app works just the same.
ui.welcome.tools.ffmpegMissing: No FFmpeg found. It is optional: you can install it now or later, in Settings.
ui.welcome.tools.intro: The app plays videos in a free player installed on the computer and uses FFmpeg, also free, to hear the actors' voice.
ui.welcome.tools.level: This computer is at the {level} level. As in a game, what is heavy starts on or off by the level; what was read, and the button to adjust again, are in Settings › General › This computer.
ui.welcome.tools.playerHelp: The app draws the subtitles over the video played by VLC or PotPlayer. Automatic uses the first one it finds.
ui.welcome.tools.title: Player and FFmpeg
